name: wrist flexion
description: Curling the hand toward the forearm, working the underside of the forearm.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Rest your forearm on a table with your hand hanging off the edge, palm up.
Curl your hand upward by bending the wrist toward your forearm.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
